lines.say: Computer science students. Two cards from the Test phase. Answer before they flip.
You want an infinite list that cycles through a, b and c. Which Haskell function?
Cycle. Not repeat. Repeat only repeats a single value.
Next. Repeated data is causing insertion anomalies. What do you apply?
Normalisation. Not an ER diagram. That models the structure, it doesn't fix it.
Offload built both from uploaded module notes. Get one wrong, and it comes back sooner.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
